rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice when repeating or reproducing something in exactly its original words.

example.english: They repeat what the teacher said verbatim to everyone.
example.traditional: 佢將老師講嘅嘢原原本本咁轉述畀大家聽。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zoeng1 lou5 si1 gong2 ge3 je5 jyun4 jyun4 bun2 bun2 gam3 zyun2 seot6 bei2 daai6 gaa1 teng1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for reproducing or recording something word for word.

example.english: I read the statement verbatim without changing any of its content.
example.traditional: 我逐字照讀份聲明，冇改過任何內容。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zuk6 zi6 ziu3 duk6 fan2 sing1 ming4 mou5 goi2 gwo3 jam6 ho4 noi6 jung4

rows.note: Use this when stressing that not a single word has been left out in the verbatim copy.

example.english: They transcribed the whole recording verbatim without leaving out a single word.
example.traditional: 佢將成段錄音一字不漏咁抄低。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zoeng1 sing4 dyun6 luk6 jam1 jat1 zi6 bat1 lau6 gam3 caau1 dai1
